name: owner_disp_break_body2x_1_0930to1000_vwap

source.title: Owner's idea in chat, 2026-10-20: 15-minute displacement, all day: a candle that closes beyond the previous candle's wick AND whose body is at least 2x the previous candle's body, entered with it

entry.words: On 1-minute NQ candles, entries decided 09:31-10:00 ET (the thirty candles 09:30-09:59): when a candle closes above the previous candle's high, its body is at least 2x the previous body and it closes ABOVE the session VWAP, go long at the close; below the previous low, body at least 2x, closing BELOW the VWAP, go short.

taught: [chat 2026-10-20] no time window trade all day, lets use displacement, lets try 15 minute frame
[chat 2026-10-20] every time we close above the previous wicks candle and the candle body is 2x bigger than the previous candles body, then long, vice versa for shorts
[chat 2026-10-20] do 9:30-10am 1 minute but only long if we are above vwap and only short if we are below (this sheet: 2x, centre 1:1)
not_run: THE EXITS were not given: Claude used the house candle-break stop (the breaking candle's extreme, floored at 0.25 x ATR(14)) and a 1:1 target; the neighbours are 1:0.75 and 1:1.25.
THE WICK: a close strictly above the previous high (long) or strictly below the previous low (short).
THE BODY: |close - open| of the breaking candle >= 2 x |close - open| of the previous candle.
FLAT: every trade is flat by 15:58 ET (13:13 on half days); no trade is held past it.
THE CAP: none (the lane's 20 a pass); one position at a time inside a pass.
COSTS AND FILLS: the engine's own (1 tick of slippage, $4 a round turn, tick replay).

THE WINDOW 09:30-10:00 is the open layer's w_start 09:30 / w_end 10:00:01 (an entry decided at a 1-minute close from 09:31 to 10:00:00); the trade then runs to its stop, target or 15:58. The random control does not wait for the window nor the VWAP (the lane's own limit).

THE VWAP: the open layer's gate vwap_dev, level 0, with: a long needs the signal candle's close above the NY session's own VWAP (volume-weighted, restarting at 09:30), a short below it; no VWAP value yet = no trade.
